scope: SEARCH-DEPTH-93: per-record result-search error isolation for over-deep on-disk JSON, CPython local CPU only; no speed or model-quality claim

implementation.procedure: Review actual ResultStore.search/show/CLI path and minimal diff; independently rerun real temporary-file cases.
implementation.acceptance: A deep record is excluded and reported without aborting unaffected retrieval; no global parser, budget, recursion-limit or trust change.

reference_boundary.procedure: List and dictionary nesting above interpreter limit, good neighboring record, all-bad/unmatched search, ordinary nesting, direct show and caller-context errors, unrelated RuntimeError/SystemExit.
reference_boundary.acceptance: All declared isolation cases pass; ordinary output matches frozen baseline and unrelated exceptions retain propagation.

data_integrity.procedure: Preserve baseline failures, fixture hashes, source SHA, commands and raw regression logs; hash inputs before/after search.
data_integrity.acceptance: Bounded real files, matching identities and unchanged bytes; no omitted failures or unrelated checkpoint publication.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Check pass-count numerator/denominator and bytes versus METADATA_LIMIT.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Report deterministic case counts, not inferred request success rates; each deep fixture below byte bound.

measurement_validity.procedure: No timing experiment; correctness pass counts only.
measurement_validity.acceptance: No latency, throughput, token, memory or model-quality benefit asserted.

reproducibility.procedure: Normal and optimized Python focused tests, full repository suite and Reader; independent frozen-baseline/candidate reproduction.
reproducibility.acceptance: Applicable regressions pass and independent review records exact limitations before publication.
